title: Balin Avenged
text:
When you play this condition, you may add a dwarven token here. While you can spot 4 dwarven tokens and 2 Dwarves, eachorcOrc gains this text "To play, remove an ¥ card from your discard pile from the game.”
Skirmish: Discard this condition to exert a minion for each Dwarf you can spot.
